fields.label: Enable FedEx Integration
fields.description: When off, FedEx shipments are skipped instead of calling the API. Mirrors the Austrian Post enable flag.

fields.label: Enable FedEx Tracking Poll
fields.description: When unchecked, the scheduled tracking poll skips FedEx. Uses the same OAuth credentials and base URL as label creation.

fields.label: API Mode
fields.description: Selects which base URL and which set of credentials is used. Sandbox and Production have SEPARATE credentials at FedEx.

fields.label: API Credentials
fields.description: FedEx issues separate credentials and shipping accounts per environment. Fill in the set matching API Mode; the other set stays untouched so you can switch back to Sandbox for development at any time.

fields.label: Sandbox Account Number
fields.description: FedEx's shared test account is 740561073. It is US-based, so Austrian domestic shipments fail with PAYMENT.PAYORCOUNTRY.INVALID.

fields.label: Production Account Number
fields.description: Must be associated with the API key at FedEx. Some European countries need a SEPARATE account for domestic shipments — the payor account's country has to match the shipment origin or destination.

fields.label: Track API Credentials
fields.description: The FedEx Developer Portal requires the Track API to live in its OWN project — it cannot be added to the Ship project. Create a "Track API" project on the same shipping account and enter its key pair here. The base URLs and account number above are shared.

fields.label: Label Image Type
fields.description: ZPLII feeds the existing raw-ZPL CUPS print path. PDF is for archiving only and cannot be sent to the label printer.

fields.label: Label Stock Type
fields.description: FedEx labelStockType, e.g. STOCK_4X6 for 4x6 inch roll stock.

fields.label: Label Resolution (DPI)
fields.description: Must match the label printer's own resolution. ZPL coordinates are in dots, so a 300 dpi label sent to a 203 dpi printer prints ~1.5x oversized and clipped. 300 is only valid with ZPLII.

fields.label: Auxiliary AWB Label (international)
fields.description: Adds the secondary Air Waybill label to international shipments as a second ^XA block in the same ZPL stream, so the printer emits two labels per parcel. FedEx requires it for International Express — and its label-evaluation team rejects approval samples without it. Turning this off halves label consumption but ships non-conforming parcels.

fields.label: Default Service Type
fields.description: Used only when the Carrier Service has no Service Code. Per-service values belong on the Carrier Service master.

fields.label: Customs
fields.description: customsClearanceDetail is sent on every shipment; FedEx itself decides whether the destination needs clearance. Electronic Trade Documents are requested only for non-EU destinations.

fields.label: Shipment Purpose
fields.options:
SOLD
GIFT
NOT_SOLD
PERSONAL_EFFECTS
REPAIR_AND_RETURN
SAMPLE

fields.label: Terms of Sale
fields.description: Incoterm printed on the commercial invoice. Max 3 characters.

fields.label: Courier Pickup
fields.description: Pickup Request API. The 12:00 run (Mon-Fri) books one FedEx Express pickup for every submitted FedEx shipment with a label that no pickup covers yet. The Parcel Station also offers a manual Request/Cancel.

fields.label: Packages Ready At
fields.description: readyDateTimestamp. Must lie before the FedEx cutoff for the pickup postal code.

fields.label: Business Closes At
fields.description: customerCloseTime. A manual request after this time books the next business day.

fields.label: Pickup Carrier
fields.description: FDXE = FedEx Express (International Priority/Economy, Regional Economy).

fields.label: Remarks for the Courier
fields.description: Sent as remarks (max 60 characters, ASCII only).

fields.label: Failure Notification Email
fields.description: Receives a mail whenever a pickup request fails. Every failure is also written to the Error Log.
